capabilities: Toggle Markdown formatting (bold, italics, highlight, inline code, comment, strikethrough, underscore) with selection expansion to the nearest word
Change checkbox/task types via a fuzzy picker modal
Promote regular bullet lines to checkbox lines
Configure extended checkbox markers and picker rows in settings
disambiguation: Not a hotkey-management tool; it adds editor commands that you bind to your own hotkeys (no default bindings are set).
extras: No default hotkey bindings; installed manually by unzipping a release archive into the plugins folder or via BRAT (untested per the author). The author accepts donations, and checkbox picker icons come from a separate snippets repo. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: thanks to obsidian-smarter-md-hotkeys for the idea and some code
problem: Obsidian's default formatting commands operate on exact selections, so partial word selections leave formatting misplaced or require manual selection adjustment.

relations.evidence: thanks to obsidian-smarter-md-hotkeys for the idea and some code
increase/decrease heading level commands were removed (out of scope) - use obsidian-heading-shifter

summary: Markdown formatting plugin that adds word-boundary-aware toggle commands for bold, italics, highlights and more, plus a fuzzy checkbox-type picker.
